sourceStatuses.evidence: Generic untrusted receive failures return before MainActor Task creation; authenticated screen rejections retain bounded admission.
Preview epoch is captured before ingress/task creation, checked for messages and nil-ID rejections, and synchronously invalidated on local terminal work.

Original replacement-overlap and producer-join defects are corrected in source. App invalidates and retains the retiring sender and passes active-or-retiring predecessor. Sender shutdown awaits drain and predecessor. Controller cancels and joins captured producer tasks. The subsequent wait-placement issue E06 is now also resolved by the focused source recheck.

Both owners begin shutdown before either await. Webcam beginShutdown now exists, invalidates permission/discovery/start eligibility, and initiates teardown. Async shutdown still waits after prior beginShutdown; the missing interface is resolved.
Visible occlusion restores eligibility only while key and app active. A new preview still requires explicit Start.

Parent corrected the publication race: immutable screenSession is assigned, then READY published, then startReplyReceiver runs. Previously the receiver could run with current generation but null screen binding. The volatile getter remains; no controller monitor is added under the coordinator lock.

Purge runs before coordinator.featureDisabled. Outbound admission requires matching current local source and paired target. Disabled-feature exceptions are limited to screen.stop and screen.state whose state is rejected. This disable callback therefore cannot purge its subsequently created terminal notice.

Coordinator currentSession reads a volatile immutable binding without the controller monitor. stop invalidates binding/generation, closes/cancels receiver and detaches outbound. stopAndAwait captures tracked receivers under the monitor, then joins receivers, coordinator and SharedOutboundBridge outside it. configure is excluded while awaitingStop. No new controller/coordinator monitor inversion was identified within this scope.

Screen request/pull/stop, unexpected screen types and sanitized authenticated rejection results go directly to the coordinator with the captured receiver generation. Screen traffic does not fall through to the generic command handler.
ScreenMirror defaults off and availability is API 34+. Manifest declares projection foreground-service permission/type and a non-exported projection service.

Activity-scoped ViewModel holds only the opaque ScreenConsentAttempt. It initializes null and has no SavedStateHandle, Bundle or persistence write. Result handling clears the attempt before forwarding it; launcher failure clears it before reporting cancellation. The consent Intent is used for launch and result forwarding without being retained by the ViewModel. This addresses the Activity-field loss on rotation by source inspection.
sourceStatuses.limitations: No rotation/process-recreation execution, compile, dependency resolution or hardware consent test. Coordinator attempt/session validity remains worker A ownership and was not re-reviewed. Framework ActivityResult saved state is not claimed to be absent; the application itself does not persist this attempt or the consent Intent.
laterAssertions: Rotate while consent is pending; the result forwards the same opaque attempt once.
Recreate the process and deliver a restored activity result; null local attempt prevents consent forwarding.

sourceStatuses.evidence: Public send now enters Queue.send immediately. Cancellation registration, bounded admission and the one-second expiry are established before drain awaits dispatchBarrier. The suspended actor drain permits cancellation and expiry methods to remove queued entries and resume callers independently. No entry is removed for dispatch or made active until the predecessor finishes; expired/cancelled entries therefore cannot dispatch after barrier release.
sourceStatuses.shutdownBoundary: Full sender shutdown still waits for the predecessor/drain, preserving replacement ordering. Scoped screen cancellation and its send callers no longer depend on that wait.
sourceStatuses.verification: Static source trace only. No new issue found in this narrow correction; runtime and compile validation remain parent-owned.
